t: Robust portable telescopic ladder built for demanding trade use. Durable, easy-clean anodised matt black finish with aircraft-grade aluminium alloy for strong, long-lasting performance. True Telescopic technology delivers controlled extension, while the automatic deployable stabiliser bar when extended ensures stability during use. Aluminium CNC-machined couplings provide a precise, rigid fit. Lightning Latch retraction and green rung-lock indicators make setup and pack-down safe and quick. Includes wall pads to protect surfaces and improve top-rung hand clearance.
